chapterInfo.content:
2
Kana ayeforɔhyia
1Na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, wɔhyiaa ayeforɔ wɔ Kana a ɛwɔ Galilea; na Yesu ne na wɔ hɔ. 2Na wɔtoo nsa frɛɛ Yesu ne n’asuafoɔ nso baa ayeforɔ no ase. 3Na nsa no anso no, Yesu ne na see no sɛ: Wɔnni nsa. 4#Yoh 19.26; Mat 12.48 Yesu see no sɛ: Ɔbaa, ɛdeɛn na me ne wo wɔ yɛ? Me dɔn nnurui! 5Na ne na see asomfoɔ no sɛ: Biribiara a ɔbɛse mo no, monyɛ! 6#Mar 7.3-4 Nso na aboɔ nsuhina nsia sisi hɔ, sɛdeɛ Yudafoɔ ahodwira teɛ, baako bɛtumi agye galɔn aduonu anaa aduasa. 7Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Momfa nsuo nhyehyɛ nhina yi mama! Na wɔhyehyɛɛ no ma tɛntɛnn. 8Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Afei monsesa mfa nkɔma adidiiɛhwɛfoɔ no! 9Na wɔde kɔeɛ. Na adidiiɛhwɛfoɔ no kaa nsuo a adane nsa no hwɛeɛ no, na ɔnnim deɛ ɛfire, (na asomfoɔ a wɔsesaa nsuo no deɛ, wɔnim) na adidiiɛhwɛfoɔ no frɛɛ ayeforɔkunu no, 10na ɔsee no sɛ: Nnipa nyinaa de nsa pa na ɛbɛsisi hɔ kane, na sɛ wɔboboro a, ɛno ansa na wɔde deɛ ɛnyɛ ba; na wo deɛ, wode nsa pa no asie abɛduru sɛsɛɛ. 11#Yoh 1.14 Yesu nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no mu deɛ ɛdi kan yi, ɔyɛɛ no Kana a ɛwɔ Galilea; na ɔyii n’animuonyam kyerɛe; na n’asuafoɔ no gyee no diiɛ. 12#Yoh 7.3 Yei akyiri no, Yesu kɔɔ Kapernaum, ɔno ne ne na, ne nuanom ne n’asuafoɔ no; na wɔanni nna bebree wɔ hɔ.
Yesu pamo adwadifoɔ firi Asɔredan no mu
(Mateo 21.12-13; Marko 11.15-17; Luka 19.45-46)
13Na Yudafoɔ Twam da abɛn, na Yesu kɔɔ Yerusalem. 14Na ɔkɔhunuu wɔn a wɔtɔn anantwie ne nnwan ne mmorɔnoma ne sikasesafoɔ sɛ wɔtete asɔrefie. 15Na ɔde homa yɛɛ mpire pamm wɔn nyinaa, nnwan ne anantwie no firii asɔrefie hɔ, na ɔhwiee sikasesafoɔ no sika guiɛ, na ɔkaa apono no butubutui; 16na ɔsee wɔn a wɔtɔn mmorɔnoma no sɛ: Momfa yeinom mfiri ha, monnyɛ m’Agya fie adwadie fie! 17#Dwom 69.9 Na n’asuafoɔ no kaee sɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Wo fie ho mmɔdemmɔ bɛhyɛ me me.
18 # Mat 21.23 Ɛnna Yudafoɔ no bua see no sɛ: Nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bɛn na wode kyerɛ yɛn a enti woyɛ yeinom? 19#Mat 26.61; 27.40 Yesu bua see wɔn sɛ: Monnwiri asɔredan yi, na mede nnansa bɛma so bio. 20Ɛnna Yudafoɔ no se: Mfirinhyia aduanan nsia na wɔde sii asɔredan yi, na wo deɛ, nnansa na wode bɛma soɔ? 21#Kol 2.9; Heb 10.10 Deɛ ɔkaeɛ no, na ɔne ne nipadua asɔredan. 22Enti, ɔsɔre firii awufoɔ mu no, n’asuafoɔ no kaee sɛ waka yei, na wɔgyee twerɛ no ne nsɛm a Yesu kaeɛ no diiɛ.
23Nso ɔwɔ Yerusalem Twam afahyɛ ase no, nnipa bebree hunuu ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔgyee ne din diiɛ. 24Na Yesu no ara deɛ, wamfa ne ho anto wɔn so, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnim wɔn nyinaa, 25#Mar 2.8 na ɛnhia no sɛ obi di onipa ho adanseɛ; ɛfiri sɛ ɔno ara nim deɛ ɛwɔ onipa mu.

Na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, wɔhyiaa ayeforɔ wɔ Kana a ɛwɔ Galilea; na Yesu ne na wɔ hɔ. Na wɔtoo nsa frɛɛ Yesu ne n’asuafoɔ nso baa ayeforɔ no ase. Na nsa no anso no, Yesu ne na see no sɛ: Wɔnni nsa. Yesu see no sɛ: Ɔbaa, ɛdeɛn na me ne wo wɔ yɛ? Me dɔn nnurui! Na ne na see asomfoɔ no sɛ: Biribiara a ɔbɛse mo no, monyɛ! Nso na aboɔ nsuhina nsia sisi hɔ, sɛdeɛ Yudafoɔ ahodwira teɛ, baako bɛtumi agye galɔn aduonu anaa aduasa. Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Momfa nsuo nhyehyɛ nhina yi mama! Na wɔhyehyɛɛ no ma tɛntɛnn. Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Afei monsesa mfa nkɔma adidiiɛhwɛfoɔ no! Na wɔde kɔeɛ. Na adidiiɛhwɛfoɔ no kaa nsuo a adane nsa no hwɛeɛ no, na ɔnnim deɛ ɛfire, (na asomfoɔ a wɔsesaa nsuo no deɛ, wɔnim) na adidiiɛhwɛfoɔ no frɛɛ ayeforɔkunu no, na ɔsee no sɛ: Nnipa nyinaa de nsa pa na ɛbɛsisi hɔ kane, na sɛ wɔboboro a, ɛno ansa na wɔde deɛ ɛnyɛ ba; na wo deɛ, wode nsa pa no asie abɛduru sɛsɛɛ. Yesu nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no mu deɛ ɛdi kan yi, ɔyɛɛ no Kana a ɛwɔ Galilea; na ɔyii n’animuonyam kyerɛe; na n’asuafoɔ no gyee no diiɛ. Yei akyiri no, Yesu kɔɔ Kapernaum, ɔno ne ne na, ne nuanom ne n’asuafoɔ no; na wɔanni nna bebree wɔ hɔ.


Na Yudafoɔ Twam da abɛn, na Yesu kɔɔ Yerusalem. Na ɔkɔhunuu wɔn a wɔtɔn anantwie ne nnwan ne mmorɔnoma ne sikasesafoɔ sɛ wɔtete asɔrefie. Na ɔde homa yɛɛ mpire pamm wɔn nyinaa, nnwan ne anantwie no firii asɔrefie hɔ, na ɔhwiee sikasesafoɔ no sika guiɛ, na ɔkaa apono no butubutui; na ɔsee wɔn a wɔtɔn mmorɔnoma no sɛ: Momfa yeinom mfiri ha, monnyɛ m’Agya fie adwadie fie! Na n’asuafoɔ no kaee sɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Wo fie ho mmɔdemmɔ bɛhyɛ me me.
Ɛnna Yudafoɔ no bua see no sɛ: Nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bɛn na wode kyerɛ yɛn a enti woyɛ yeinom? Yesu bua see wɔn sɛ: Monnwiri asɔredan yi, na mede nnansa bɛma so bio. Ɛnna Yudafoɔ no se: Mfirinhyia aduanan nsia na wɔde sii asɔredan yi, na wo deɛ, nnansa na wode bɛma soɔ? Deɛ ɔkaeɛ no, na ɔne ne nipadua asɔredan. Enti, ɔsɔre firii awufoɔ mu no, n’asuafoɔ no kaee sɛ waka yei, na wɔgyee twerɛ no ne nsɛm a Yesu kaeɛ no diiɛ.
Nso ɔwɔ Yerusalem Twam afahyɛ ase no, nnipa bebree hunuu ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔgyee ne din diiɛ. Na Yesu no ara deɛ, wamfa ne ho anto wɔn so, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnim wɔn nyinaa, na ɛnhia no sɛ obi di onipa ho adanseɛ; ɛfiri sɛ ɔno ara nim deɛ ɛwɔ onipa mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
